company.name: Anfas Medical Care
company.shortDescription: Anfas Medical Care offers palliative care, radiology services, respiratory therapy, and dialysis care.
company.description: Anfas Medical Care is a hospital for patients with lung problems requiring mechanical ventilation. They offer laboratory services, long-term care, palliative care, radiology services, respiratory therapy, ICU care, rehabilitation, urgent care, home health care, and dialysis care. They provide pre-analytical testing services, a clinical chemistry department, an immunology and serology section, diagnostic microbiology tests, and blood products.
